name: qs1qgx-container-viewer
goal: Prove the viewer can navigate a focused popup, and an eligible Hub ask opens the MB2 viewer only through Cloudflare identity and device approval.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Stock popup lacks browser chrome. Viewer delegates navigation to focused Chromium tab. Hub opens a protected top-level viewer from the corresponding ask. The origin preserves device approval after Cloudflare authentication.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The preexisting gate checks pairing and VNC only. Its approved-device test now checks the navigation surface. Existing desktop and phone Needs You row tests now open the per-item viewer detail and follow the exact protected origin.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Real paired Chromium popup timed out waiting for Back on harbor-mbp-2. Hub link red at desktop, tablet and phone widths.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Implemented paired popup navigation, 15-minute Access and device approvals, and a shared Hub ask detail.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged Chromium popup test passed on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
